system.description: Your unarmed strikes may be infused with Chakra that lashes out and attacks the meridians of your target. Ignore non-magical armor with any unarmed attack, and whenever you strike a target, if it possesses Chakra it loses one point of Chakra per successful attack. If you successfully strike a ninja of Arcane Might equal to you or less while they are at zero Chakra you may seal their Chakra for up to a week, or till someone with this technique of equal or greater Arcane Might to you frees them.
